verdict.rationale: Spline documents an official Spline MCP Server on a dedicated docs page. It connects MCP clients such as Claude, Cursor, Codex, VS Code, Antigravity and ChatGPT to the open editor, ships bundled in the desktop app, and the app auto-registers with the clients it finds. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration, no documented tool catalog or scope of agent actions, and MCP works only in the desktop app, not the browser editor.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The **Spline MCP Server** connects AI coding tools like **Claude**, **Cursor**, **Codex**, and **Antigravity** directly to your Spline editor.
The MCP server is bundled in the desktop app, so connecting Claude, Cursor, VS Code, Antigravity or ChatGPT to your editor only works here — there's nothing to install or configure
Spline MCP Server — drive Spline from Claude, Cursor, Codex and other MCP clients, straight into your open editor tab.
